title: Expose image orientation metadata on HTMLImageElement
body:
Fixes #5602.

<!--
Thank you for contributing to the HTML Standard! Please describe the change you are making and complete the checklist below if your change is not editorial.
-->

This exposes EXIF orientation metadata of an image on `HTMLImageElement`. EXIF orientation consists of a rotation (a multiple of 90 degrees) followed by an optional horizontal flip around the center of the image. Not sure if we need to design the API surface to consider any other hypothetical image orientations than those allowed by EXIF. Also interested to hear opinions on whether this makes sense to expose as two separate IDL attributes (as is done in the PR), or as an object with separate `angle` and `flip` IDL attributes on it, or as a function that returns a dictionary with `angle` and `flip` members.
